parts.answer: A sign change occurs between $\theta=2.2$ and $\theta=2.4$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Calculate values of a relevant expression or pair at $\theta=2.2$ and $2.4$ — M1; e.g. with $f(\theta)=\frac\pi2+\sin\theta$, $f(2.2)=2.37\ldots>2.2$ and $f(2.4)=2.24\ldots<2.4$, or with $f(\theta)=\theta-\frac\pi2-\sin\theta$, obtain opposite signs. Complete the argument correctly with correct values — A1. Total: 2.
